plan.title: Drug-treated vs control liver DE: DESeq2 + edgeR
plan.analytical_narrative: Lexogen QuantSeq 3' tag-seq, 3 treated vs 3 control human liver, 12000 genes, raw STAR/featureCounts counts. Plan: blind-vst sample structure QC (PCA, distances, library sizes), minimal low-count pre-filter (floor 5 counts in 3 samples, per 3'-tag rule R-0080), median-of-ratios normalization inside DESeq2 with a GC-bias diagnostic (no length correction — 3' tag counts are length-independent; TPM/FPKM does not apply), explicit reference level, Wald test with BH at alpha 0.05 with independent filtering, apeglm LFC shrinkage, and a parallel edgeR quasi-likelihood run for robustness; the intersection of the two gene sets is the high-confidence DE set. Report includes power statement (3 replicates/group = low power; only large-effect genes will be found), MA and dispersion diagnostics, p-value histogram, Cook's-distance outlier NAs, and full reproducibility record.
